Subject: Recap: trial procurement path & billing start

Lina — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before looping procurement:

- What we covered: trial scope (hosted API, 100k tokens/day baseline), success criteria (accuracy on sample prompts, latency <= 250ms p95, integration with your staging VPC), and procurement options (card pilot vs PO, marketplace listing).
- Action items for VoxWare: confirm procurement route (PO vs card vs marketplace) and invoicing details (billing address + remit), identify procurement contact.
- Redwood asks: confirm trial start date and agree success metrics/usage gate so billing transition is predictable.

Suggested plan:
1) Start pilot on June 22 (2-week evaluation).
2) Redwood provisions a dedicated trial quota and shares a short trial plan and SOW draft (attached).
3) If success criteria met, billing converts to paid on the agreed go-live date (we recommend starting billing the Monday after the trial end unless you prefer immediate conversion on sign-off).

Attached: redwood-trial-plan-voxware.docx (trial checklist), redwood-quote-voxware-20260615.pdf (pricing/terms).

Would you confirm: (a) procurement route, (b) preferred trial start date (June 22 OK?), and (c) who on your side signs SOW / issues PO?

Thanks — I’ll keep Sean on copy for technical follow-ups.

— Alex Martinez

- Procurement path: procurement will prefer a PO for anything that moves beyond a small credit-card pilot. For the initial pilot we can either put it on a corporate card or issue a PO depending on how quickly we can get legal to review the SOW.
- Marketplace: we are interested in marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) but that will take extra time; we need to check whether your current offer is listed.
- Invoicing details: billing should go to VoxWare Inc., 1201 Market St, SF, CA 94103. Finance contact is marcus.lee@voxware.com and procurement is procurement@voxware.com.

Procurement note: they will need SOC 2 documentation and an invoice template. Can you share SOC 2 and standard PO terms?

June 22 as a pilot start works for our team as long as procurement can either sign the SOW or issue a provisional PO by then. I’ll loop in procurement and Marcus on the next message.

- Marketplace: we currently have an AWS Marketplace listing pending for our curated models; marketplace procurement typically adds 2–3 weeks to provisioning depending on procurement team. If that’s important we can accommodate but it would not block a June 22 pilot.
- Compliance docs: attaching our SOC 2 summary and a standard PO/invoice template.

Proposal: start pilot June 22; Redwood will provision trial quota now and keep the trial configuration flexible (card or PO). If metrics are met by end of pilot (see trial plan), we can convert to paid and have billing start July 6 (Monday after trial ends). If you prefer billing to start immediately on conversion that’s fine — we’ll follow whatever VoxWare prefers.

Looping Sean for the KV cache and latency test plan — Sean, can you confirm the p95 latency targets and any required headers for the staging calls?
